name: Outcome-Without-Sacrifice
surface: B2B SaaS Heroes, App Value Propositions
blueprintProse:
This framework links an ambitious operational achievement to the absolute preservation of a resource typically sacrificed during execution. Structurally, 30% defines the category, 35% articulates the outcome, and 35% eliminates the expected compromise. 
The cognitive driver is trade-off resistance. High-consideration buyers frequently stall when forced to balance conflicting priorities, such as development velocity versus security compliance. Promising the primary outcome while guaranteeing zero compromise on secondary priorities removes this decision friction.
